candidates.title: Big Sur 1964: UFO filmed disabling Atlas test missile
candidates.place_text: Vandenberg Air Force Base / Big Sur, California
candidates.quote: A flying saucer flying 8,000 miles per hour, not only seemed to encircle the missile, it shot four directed energy beams at it, causing it to tumble off its intended trajectory.

candidates.title: Bob Jacobs recalls filming the Big Sur missile launch
candidates.quote: And the missile popped up through the fog. All we saw was a smoke trail going off into subspace.

candidates.title: AATIP studied UFOs 2007-2012
candidates.quote: That's Lou Elizondo, former director of AATIP, the government's Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program, which studied UFOs from 2007 to 2012.

candidates.title: Malmstrom 1967: red object shuts down missiles (Salas)
candidates.quote: In March of 1967 at Malmstrom Nuclear Facility in Montana, Captain Robert Salas was operating an underground control center capable of deploying 10 80 kiloton nuclear warheads at any moment.

candidates.title: Trinity crash, August 1945
candidates.quote: Famous ufologist Jacques Vallée's new book describes a crash at Trinity, New Mexico on August 17th, 1945.

candidates.title: Declassified Air Force documents on UFOs at Cold War nuclear sites
candidates.place_text: Hanford, Washington; Savannah, South Carolina; Fort Hood, Texas; Los Alamos; Malmstrom; F.E. Warren
candidates.quote: From hundreds of declassified Air Force documents, we now know that UFO sightings were happening across all American nuclear production, missile storage and deployment sites throughout the Cold War,

candidates.title: Emergency conference at Camp Hood on nuclear-site UFOs
candidates.quote: an emergency conference was held at Camp Hood, Texas, which included the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Army Counter Intelligence Command, and the FBI.

candidates.title: Tom DeLonge, To The Stars Academy and Lockheed Martin
candidates.quote: But then he's like getting in touch with Lockheed Martin and meeting with executives there.

candidates.title: DeLonge in secure facilities
candidates.quote: I have been in secure facilities, you know, the codes and the alarms and the guns and all that shit to get into there and they lock you in and they're airtight

candidates.title: DeLonge emails in the Podesta leak
candidates.quote: you can see in the emails which are on Podesta, he's saying like, I want the government to come off as cool here,

candidates.title: Obama administration's UFO answers, then Obama's late-night statement
candidates.quote: I think as recently as like 2012, the Obama administration had was asked if they investigate UFOs and it was just kind of like left off.

candidates.title: Obama: footage and records of unknown objects
candidates.quote: There's footage and records of objects in the skies that we don't know exactly what they are.

candidates.title: Jimmy Carter's sighting
candidates.quote: Yeah, Jimmy Carter saying um he he saw a bright light appear in the distance uh Western skies.

candidates.title: John Trump examines Tesla's files
candidates.quote: He was so smart that when Nicola Tesla died, he was called upon by the government to um basically investigate all of his personal files and just kind of like go through like all of his notes and whatnot.

candidates.title: General Spaatz flew to Texas during Roswell
candidates.quote: And in fact, he flew to Texas, which is where the Roswell retrieve parts were supposedly taken before they were taken to Wright-Patterson.

candidates.title: John Trump likely involved in the 1952 Washington wave
candidates.quote: I personally think he would have been involved in, for example, the 1952 wave over DC, which was a very radar-intensive wave.

candidates.title: Majestic 12
candidates.quote: So, this is like a reported committee in the in the I guess 40s and 50s and like, you know, Nathan Twining, James Forrestal, Vannevar Bush, people like that.

candidates.title: Roswell's atomic bomber squadron
candidates.quote: Roswell was the first atomically armed bomber squadron and they were the ones that dropped the bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

candidates.title: Sightings at Los Alamos from 1948
candidates.quote: And then you have Los Alamos, like even as early as I believe like 1948, they're being seen there.

candidates.title: Nukes used to bring down UFOs
candidates.quote: And yeah, Tom says that uh they've used nukes to like bring down UFOs, right?

candidates.title: EMP from nuclear blast travels through dimensions
candidates.quote: The one thing we found out is that the EMP wave from a nuclear blast kind of travels through multiple dimensions.

candidates.title: 1952 official denial of secret development
candidates.quote: We can say that the recent sightings are in no way connected with any secret development by any department of the United States.

candidates.title: First H-bomb and the 1952 DC wave
candidates.quote: What happened in 1952? The DC UFO sightings in in July.

candidates.title: The 1952 Pacific H-bomb as a signal to others
candidates.quote: The concern that I have is that in 1952, what if there was someone there to hear what we said in the Pacific? We said we are a hair's breadth away from being in possession of God-like knowledge.

candidates.title: Touching craft pieces with Garry Nolan
candidates.quote: Like I've seen pieces of a craft. I've been with Garry Nolan. I don't know if they're real pieces of a craft, but like they seem.

candidates.title: Richard Doty and Paul Bennewitz
candidates.quote: So Paul Benewitz sees, you know, these sort of super advanced uh aircraft being tested, and then Doty sort of enters the picture and like starts to drive him mad.

candidates.title: James McDonald's 1957 sighting and Project Blue Book
candidates.quote: He submitted it to the Air Force. He had thought that it was everything was going well, you know what I mean?

candidates.title: McDonald confronts Hynek
candidates.quote: A big part of the reason why he ended up flipping if you will, or coming clean was because James McDonald went to him and was like super pissed and was like, what you're doing to science is horrible.

candidates.title: McDonald mocked in congressional hearings after the Michigan flap
candidates.quote: And a congressman like famously like mocked that he was into UFOs and stuff like that. And like apparently the entire like congressional hall like was laughing at him.

candidates.title: Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment in space
candidates.quote: Uh but he tried to do it while he was in orbit. It was the first ever like psychic experiment in space.

candidates.title: Edgar Mitchell's conversion on return from the Moon
candidates.quote: What I I find so interesting about him is it almost felt like he had like a conversion experience on the way back from the moon on Apollo 14.

candidates.title: Mitchell hears of Roswell from residents and von Braun
candidates.quote: And then like shortly after that too is when Werner von Braun like told him that like I also kind of corroborate what you were hearing back home about Roswell.

candidates.title: Occult history in NASA and launch pad choices
candidates.quote: There's a lot of occult history, occult history in NASA. Some of the the nomenclature that was used for certain missions and and the choosing of, you know, launch pad 33 and some other things were very deliberate.

candidates.title: Jack Parsons' past life as Simon the Sorcerer
candidates.quote: So, Jack Parsons was in the the OTO, you know, this uh crazy cult, you know, with Alistair Crowley and all that, and they would do past life regressions.

candidates.title: Host's visit to Skinwalker Ranch
candidates.quote: Like a tri-field meter went off because of high gamma radiation.

candidates.title: Neil Armstrong said to have seen UFOs on the Moon
candidates.quote: and then there's the UFO conspiracy that they were that uh Neil Armstrong saw like UFOs on the moon or whatever. And and he came back and he was super scared.

candidates.title: Neil Armstrong's Tayos Cave expedition
candidates.quote: Uh and it was called the Tayos Cave, and it was supposed to contain ancient alien metallic artifacts.
